name: v00-context
source:
C4Context
  title System Context for Internet Banking
  Person(customer, "Personal Banking Customer", "A customer of the bank")
  Enterprise_Boundary(b0, "Bank") {
    System(banking, "Internet Banking System", "Lets customers view accounts")
    SystemDb(ledger, "Ledger", "Stores transactions")
  }
  System_Ext(mail, "E-mail System", "Sends e-mails")
  Rel(customer, banking, "Uses", "HTTPS")
  Rel(banking, ledger, "Reads from and writes to")
  Rel(banking, mail, "Sends e-mail using", "SMTP")
  Rel_Back(customer, mail, "Sends e-mails to")

name: v01-grid
source:
C4Context
  title Nine systems, three rows
  Person(p1, "Alice", "Admin")
  Person(p2, "Bob", "Customer with a rather long description that has to wrap across lines")
  System(s1, "Alpha")
  System_Ext(s2, "Beta Payments Gateway", "Third party")
  SystemDb(s3, "Gamma Store", "Keeps data")
  SystemQueue(s4, "Delta Bus", "Moves events")
  System(s5, "Epsilon")
  System(s6, "Zeta")
  System(s7, "Eta")
  Rel(p1, s1, "Manages")
  Rel(p2, s2, "Pays with")
  Rel(s1, s3, "Reads from", "SQL")
  Rel(s4, s5, "Delivers to")
  Rel(s6, p1, "Notifies")
  Rel(s7, s3, "Backs up")

name: v04-nested
v05-containers
source:
C4Container
  title Containers with every shape
  Person(u, "Shopper")
  System_Boundary(sys, "Store") {
    Container(web, "Web App", "React", "Storefront and checkout flows for shoppers")
    Container(api, "API", "Node.js", "Business logic")
    ContainerDb(db, "Database", "Postgres", "Orders")
    ContainerQueue(q, "Events", "Kafka", "Domain events")
    Container_Ext(m, "Mailer", "SaaS")
    ComponentDb(cdb, "Cache", "Redis")
  }
  Rel(u, web, "Browses", "HTTPS")
  Rel(web, api, "Calls", "JSON")
  Rel(api, db, "Reads/writes", "SQL")
  BiRel(api, q, "Publishes/consumes", "AMQP")
  Rel(q, m, "Triggers")
  Rel(api, cdb, "Caches in")
  Rel_Back(u, m, "Sends mail to")

name: v06-component
source:
C4Component
  Container_Boundary(api, "API Application") {
    Component(sign, "Sign-in controller", "Spring MVC", "Lets users sign in")
    Component(sec, "Security component", "Spring Bean", "Checks credentials and rate-limits repeated attempts")
    ComponentQueue(jobs, "Jobs", "SQS")
    Component_Ext(ext, "Identity provider", "OIDC")
  }
  ContainerDb(db, "Database", "Oracle")
  Rel(sign, sec, "Uses")
  Rel(sec, db, "Reads from", "JDBC")
  Rel(sec, ext, "Delegates to", "HTTPS")
  Rel(sign, jobs, "Enqueues")
